provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled ideal dilute diprotic ampholyte, with the three listed states only. Ka1 describes cation to zwitterion plus proton; Ka2 describes zwitterion to anion plus proton. pH is externally buffered and activities are approximated by concentrations. Fraction ratios cation:zwitterion:anion=10^(pKa1-pH):1:10^(pH-pKa2). Ignore conformer populations and activity corrections.
target: Use each original state graph formal charge to obtain the ensemble mean charge at every pH. The isoelectric pH has zero mean charge in this model. A net-zero zwitterion still contains charged atoms; zero mean over an ensemble is separate from every member having zero net charge.
scope: Stipulated protonation thermodynamics, not measured glycine pKa, a physiological effect or automatic pH prediction from a neutral graph.
